get.summary: Returns the loudness envelope of a song.
get.description: OpenSubsonic extension name `songWaveform` (As returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`). Returns the loudness envelope of a song: the RMS level in dBFS (-120 to 0, rounded to 2 decimal places), at a fixed base resolution of one value per 100 ms, optionally reduced to `samples` values by keeping the highest value of each group.

parameters.name: samples
parameters.description: The number of values to return. If omitted, or greater than or equal to the number of base values (`ceil(duration × 10)`), the server returns all base values. Otherwise the server returns exactly this many values, each the highest of a group of consecutive base values.

post.summary: Returns the loudness envelope of a song.
post.description:
OpenSubsonic extension name `songWaveform` (As returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`). Returns the loudness envelope of a song: the RMS level in dBFS (-120 to 0, rounded to 2 decimal places), at a fixed base resolution of one value per 100 ms, optionally reduced to `samples` values by keeping the highest value of each group.

Requires OpenSubsonic extension name `formPost` (As returned by `getOpenSubsonicExtensions`)

samples.description: The number of values to return. If omitted, or greater than or equal to the number of base values (`ceil(duration × 10)`), the server returns all base values. Otherwise the server returns exactly this many values, each the highest of a group of consecutive base values.
